item.title: Learning Bazzite and Fedora
item.description: Obviously, I like working with computers. Ironically, I've never really owned a high end computer. I had a Sony Vaio way back in the day that was supposed to be a great gaming maching but that was before discrete GPUs. This last year, I finally built a really nice PC for myself.
